newsitem.title: USA: Raymond James to sell Liberty interest.
newsitem.headline: Raymond James to sell Liberty interest.

text.p: Raymond James Financial Inc said on Tuesday it had agreed in principle with Liberty Investment Management Inc for Raymond James to receive a lump sum settlement for its remaining three years' interest in Liberty's revenue stream.
Liberty recently announced it had entered into an acquisition agreement with Goldman Sachs Asset Management.
The amount and timing of payments to Raymond James are contingent on the occurrence of several events prior to or shortly after the scheduled closing date in January.
The maximum amount that Raymond James could realize from the deal is about $30 million pre-tax, the company said.
Raymond James Chairman Thomas James said, "The probable gain to be recorded in the near term will be offset by a sooner-than-expected drop in our revenue stream from Liberty.

"We are optimistic that our progress in rebuiliding the institutional equity asset management business of Eagle (Asset Management) will continue, if not accelerate, to enable us to replace this revenue source."
